title: School-age suicides in South Korea rise 65 percent in 5 years

blocks.text: The number of suicides among Korean schoolchildren reached its highest level on record in 2025, up 65 percent from 2020, government data showed Sunday. A total of 244 elementary, middle and high school students died by suicide in 2025, the highest number since records began, according to Education Ministry data obtained by Rep. Kim Moon-soo
